title: RecentPage
description: GET /recent on the broker, proxied unchanged by the admin as GET /api/egress/recent: one keyset page of decided rows, newest first (decided_at DESC, request_id DESC), each in the same shape as queue_snapshot().recent, plus the cursor of the next page. next is the last row's decided_at and request_id joined by a comma, passed back as ?before=; it is null when fewer than limit rows remained. Errors are error_response.
$comment: Built by EgressBroker.recent_page and decided_row_json in src/egress_broker_host.py.

status.$comment: CLOSE_STATUSES in src/egress_store.py; recent rows are decided (closed) rows.

scope.$comment: Allow scopes ('live','manifest') in _close_request plus VALID_DECIDE_SCOPES ('once','bottle','global') in src/egress_denylist.py; null when never set.

decided_by.$comment: decided_by values written in src/egress_broker_host.py: /decide handler ('operator'/'ntfy'), sweep_stale ('sweep'), _denylist_short_circuit ('denylist').

apply_status.$comment: APPLY_OUTCOMES in src/egress_store.py; null when no allow was attempted.
